theme.title: The 2020s
theme.subtitle: Recent records
theme.recap: A 41st pick won Finals MVP, an eighth seed reached the Finals and a rebuilding Spurs team lost 18 in a row.

questions.prompt: In 2023 Nikola Jokić became the lowest draft pick ever to win Finals MVP. Where was he picked in 2014?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: He became the lowest-selected player to ever win Finals MVP, being the 41st pick of the 2014 NBA draft

questions.prompt: As an eighth seed, Miami beat Milwaukee in 2023. How many points did Jimmy Butler score in his career-high game in that series?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: scoring a career-high 56 points in a 119–114 victory

questions.prompt: How many regular-season games did the 2022–23 Heat win before reaching the Finals?
questions.note: 44–38, then a run to the Finals as an eighth seed.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: They regressed from their 53–29 record the previous season and finished with a record of 44–38

questions.prompt: Nikola Jokić led the 2023 playoffs in points, rebounds and assists. How many points did he score?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: became the first player in NBA history to lead the league in points (600), rebounds (269), and assists (190)

questions.prompt: In Victor Wembanyama's rookie year, San Antonio lost how many games in a row?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: lost 18 consecutive games between November 5 and December 15, the longest losing streak in franchise history.
